description: Contract vectors of the tool names: the ten ledger write tools and the five attachment tools carry the host attestation, the read tools never do. The attestation of a tool is issued for exactly the name in this file (the attachment tools are hyphenated, not ledger_...). The nine ledger write tools (all but ledger_whoami) take a required operationKey, and the claim's operation key is that argument; whoami and the attachment tools have no operation key in the claim: it is empty. The hook (WriteTool) and the server (ToolContract) are two programs, so both test against this file.
